quotes.terms_html:
TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR RENOVATION WORKS

1. Agreement

These Terms and Conditions form part of the Renovation Contract entered into between the Homeowner/Client, Olivia Martinez, and the Contractor/Company, Demo Studio Pte Ltd, for the renovation works described in this quotation.

2. Scope of Works

The works are limited to the items listed in this quotation. Additional works, changes of material or changes to the approved drawings are variations and will be quoted and agreed in writing before they are carried out.

3. Validity and Pricing

This quotation is valid for 30 days from its date of issue. Prices are in Singapore dollars and include GST where stated. Quantities marked as estimates are re-measured on site before the relevant works begin.

4. Payment

Payment follows the schedule set out in this quotation. Works commence only after the deposit has been received. An invoice unpaid for more than 7 days may lead to the works being suspended until the outstanding amount is settled.

5. Timeline

The completion timeline is indicative and depends on material lead times, site access and the timely confirmation of drawings and selections. Demo Studio Pte Ltd will inform the Client of any change to the timeline as early as possible.

6. Permits and Compliance

Where a permit is required, Demo Studio Pte Ltd will apply for it on the Client’s behalf. All works comply with the guidelines of the relevant authorities and the building management, and any fee they impose is borne by the Client.

7. Materials and Warranty

Materials are as specified in this quotation or of equivalent quality where the specified item is unavailable. Workmanship for carpentry, wet works and electrical works is warranted for 12 months from handover, excluding wear and tear, misuse and alterations by other parties.

8. Cancellation

Should the Client cancel after the works have commenced, the Client pays for all works completed and materials ordered up to the date of cancellation.

For any query on these terms, contact Demo Studio Pte Ltd at 6222 0188. Prepared by Dane.
quotes.notes_html: Prices are inclusive of GST at 9%. Works are scheduled to start on about 15 Sep ’26 and run for about 10 weeks; the dates move with material lead times and the confirmation of selections.

quote_text_templates.title: Terms and Conditions for HDB Works
quote_text_templates.body:
TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR HDB WORKS

1. Renovation Permit

Works in an HDB flat are carried out under an HDB renovation permit applied for by [Studio Name], a Registered Renovation Contractor. The permit is valid for 3 months from its date of issue and works are scheduled within that period.

2. Permitted Hours

General renovation works are carried out between 9am and 6pm on weekdays and Saturdays. Noisy works such as hacking and drilling are limited to 9am to 5pm on weekdays and are not carried out on Sundays or public holidays.

3. Hacking and Structural Works

Structural walls, columns and beams will not be hacked. Wall demolition and floor hacking are carried out only where HDB has approved them and within the limits stated in the permit.

4. Wet Areas

Flats within their first three years from key collection keep HDB’s waterproofing on the bathroom floors; tiling in those bathrooms is carried out without disturbing the existing waterproofing membrane.

5. Disposal and Common Areas

Debris is bagged and removed daily. Common corridors and lift lobbies are protected during the works and left clean at the end of each day.

6. Payment and Warranty

Payment follows the schedule in this quotation. Workmanship is warranted for 12 months from handover. Prepared for [Client Full Name] by [Team Member Full Name], [Studio Name], [Studio Phone Number].

quote_text_templates.title: Terms and Conditions for BTO Works
quote_text_templates.body:
TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR BTO WORKS

1. Defects Check

Works begin only after the Client has completed the defects inspection with HDB’s Building Service Centre and the reported defects have been rectified, so that HDB’s defects liability period is not affected by the renovation.

2. Renovation Permit

[Studio Name] applies for the HDB renovation permit before any work starts. Optional Component Scheme fittings the flat came with are removed only where the Client has confirmed it in writing.

3. Timeline

A whole-flat renovation for a new BTO flat typically runs 8 to 12 weeks from commencement, depending on carpentry lead times and the confirmation of selections. The dates in this quotation are estimates.

4. Selections

Laminates, tiles, sanitary ware and fittings are to be confirmed before the works commence. Changes after an item has been ordered are variations charged at cost.

5. Payment and Warranty

Payment follows the schedule in this quotation. Workmanship is warranted for 12 months from handover. Prepared for [Client Full Name] by [Team Member Full Name], [Studio Name], [Studio Phone Number].

quote_text_templates.title: Working Hours and Site Access
quote_text_templates.body: Works are carried out from 9am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday. Please arrange for the keys or access card to be handed to [Team Member Full Name] before the commencement date, and register [Studio Name] with the building management where the estate requires it.

quote_text_templates.title: Material Lead Times
quote_text_templates.body: Laminate carpentry is fabricated 2 to 3 weeks after the drawings are confirmed; quartz worktops are cut 2 weeks after templating; imported sanitary ware and lighting take 4 to 6 weeks. Selections confirmed late move the dates in the schedule accordingly.

quote_text_templates.title: What This Quote Excludes
quote_text_templates.body: This quotation excludes the removal of existing furniture, electrical supply upgrades by SP Group, permit and management fees imposed by the authorities or the building, and items purchased by the Client directly. Contact [Studio Name] at [Studio Phone Number] to add any of these.
